name: Share sheet and share extensions
plain: Receives or sends content through the system share menu.
meaning: Any app can offer to take shared files or text. The system shows suggested people, so the app can learn who the sender usually shares with.

android.permission: None; ShareTarget in manifest, sharing shortcuts
android.note: Sharesheet shows app targets and direct share people; Android 14 adds custom actions.

ios.permission: Share extension target in the app extension
ios.note: iOS shows suggestions from Siri intelligence; extensions run in separate sandbox.

limits.headline: Can send or receive content through the share menu, after you pick where it goes
limits.user_action: You tap Share and choose an app or person
can: Send a link, picture or file to another app
Receive things other apps share with it
Show people suggestions like Direct Share on Android or Siri suggestions on iPhone
cannot: Send anything without you choosing a target
See other apps' data except what you share
Run share extensions on iPhone outside their own sandbox
limits.reach_label: Only what you share, one time
limits.differs: Android Sharesheet shows app and direct share targets. iPhone extensions run in a separate sandbox.

story.what_it_is: The system menu for sending content to other apps, and for apps to receive it.

marketing.name: App extensions
marketing.pitch: Apple describes share extensions as a way for apps to take content from other apps through the system share menu.

marketing.name: Share content
marketing.pitch: Google documents how apps send and receive content through the Android sharesheet.

story.for_you: You tap Share on a photo and see apps and people you message often. You pick one and the content is sent. You may not know the system chose those people based on your habits.
story.for_makers: Makers get content from other apps and a quick path to send theirs. The suggested people also let the system and apps learn who you share with.

use_cases.example: You share a photo straight to a friend in a chat app.
You share a song link to a friend.
You save a web page to your notes app.
You share a product with family.
You send a place to a friend.
You share a game score or invite link.
A site adds share buttons that quietly record what you share.

story.android_note: The sharesheet shows app targets and direct people. Android 14 adds custom actions.
story.ios_note: iOS suggests people from Siri. Extensions run in their own sandbox.

linkedin.how: Share to LinkedIn is a common target from browsers and news apps. Exact manifest entries unverified.
